en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a flat rural landscape with canals, fields, and traditional Dutch windmills. One large windmill stands prominently on the left side near the water, with another windmill visible further in the distance to the right. Small farm buildings and a figure walking along the canal bank are also visible. Printed caption text appears at the top in a serif font.
